messages.text: The K. pulls 800 W at the wall — about 576 kWh a month, so roughly $58 at 10¢/kWh. What do you pay for power?

800 W either way — watts don't change with voltage. On 220 V that's about 3.6 A, versus ~6.7 A at 110 V, so a lighter circuit load.

Worth knowing: the KBeast isn't on sale right now. The Magic Miner 40T, the other one you looked at, is live at $799. Want the numbers on it?

On the Magic Miner it's all in the Harlo OS web interface — you open the miner's IP in a browser and set pool URL, worker, and the frequency/voltage preset. No flashing, no command line.

Fair warning: pushing it past the stock preset counts as overclocking, and that voids the warranty. Most people run it stock.

Want me to run the sats and power numbers for the 40T at your rate?
